facts.fact: Resolution 17/2018, approved by the Council of Ministers on 20 March 2018 and in force on publication in the Boletim da Republica on 21 June 2018, approves the Information Society Policy of Mozambique, which sets vision, mission, principles, objectives and seven axes including access and connectivity and policies and regulation.
facts.system: Política para a Sociedade da Informação

facts.fact: The full text of the policy is printed in the official gazette (Boletim da Republica, I Serie, no. 122, 21 June 2018), which the source links from the INTIC official site.
facts.system: Política para a Sociedade da Informação

facts.fact: The policy states no end date or review year; it revokes Resolution 28/2000 (the 2000 Informatics Policy) and is complemented by a Strategic Plan with a ten-year horizon, which the document describes but does not contain.
facts.system: Política para a Sociedade da Informação

facts.fact: The policy says it is complemented by an Operational Plan that sets the actions, those responsible and the calendar for each five years of the Strategic Plan, with no cost stated in this document; the plan itself is not in the gazette issue.
facts.system: Política para a Sociedade da Informação

facts.fact: Resolution 19/2018, published in the same gazette issue (approved 26 March 2018), gives the National Institute of Electronic Government (INAGE), supervised by the minister for ICT, the competence to mobilise the financial, material and human resources for the Information Society Policy, Strategic Plan and Operational Plan, and to propose ICT policies and strategies to the Council of Ministers.
facts.system: Política para a Sociedade da Informação

facts.fact: The policy says its implementation will depend on mobilising internal and external financial resources and private investment, and that a financing mechanism will be identified and created, without naming a budget line.
facts.system: Política para a Sociedade da Informação
